list.title: CollectionObject#_processFiles
list.description: Iterate through all the entities in the crate with type File and ensure that the file is imported.

list.title: CollectionObject#addToRepo
list.description: Create an OCFL object in the repository and add all the required files. By default, all the file defined in the File entities in the crate will be imported to the OCFL automatically. To avoid that set ignoreFilesInCrate to false, for example, during testing. Use the files parameter to manually re-import only some specific files.

list.title: CollectionObject#importFile
list.description: Add a file or directory in the local file system to the queue to be imported to the OCFL repository.

list.title: CollectionObject#writeFile
list.description: Write data into a file in the temp dir and add it to the crate

list.title: Collector#newObject
list.description: Create a new collection object for ingestion into the OCFL repository. If crate is provided, that in-memory ROCrate instance will be used. Otherwise, metadata will be loaded from cratePath/ro-crate-metadata.json.
